format: NetCDF4 (GLM-L2-LCFA, ~20 s files) binned to 0.1-degree grid
origin: AWS S3 s3://noaa-goes16 (satellite=east resolves to G16 before 2025-04-04, G19 s3://noaa-goes19 after)
unverified: glm_variables is derived from the checkpoint's variable list at load time (stormscope.py:2251); glm_density taken from docstring/example/recipe, no checkpoint loaded.
notes: StormScopeMRMS (model_name 3km_10min_flash) reads its glm_density state channel from GOESGLMGrid(satellite='east'); same time as the example start_date (03_stormscope_goes_example.py:156).
The source also offers glm_energy_density (goes_glm.py:954-957), which no model reads.
One 5-minute bin [t, t+5min) = 17 LCFA files, parsed with a CONUS bbox. The model itself fetches a multi-step window per call; this spec times a single bin.
